# incident_ip_allowlist (Data Source)

Manage the IP allowlist.

When enabled, the IP allowlist restricts authenticated traffic from the dashboard, public API and mobile app.

Use this data source to read the organisation's IP allowlist: whether it is enabled, and the IP addresses or CIDR prefixes that are allowed to reach the dashboard, public API and mobile app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the organisation's IP allowlist.
data "incident_ip_allowlist" "current" {}

output "allowed_addresses" {
  description = "IP addresses and CIDR prefixes allowed to access this workspace"
  value       = [for item in data.incident_ip_allowlist.current.allowlist : item.value]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allowlist` (Attributes Set) A list of IP addresses or CIDR prefixes to allow (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowlist))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this IP allowlist is enabled or not
- `updated_at` (String) The time this allowlist was last updated
- `version` (Number) The version of this IP allowlist

<a id="nestedatt--allowlist"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allowlist`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) A label to help identify this IP or prefix
- `value` (String) An IP address or a CIDR IP prefix to allow
